compute_mask_iou: compute pairwise intersection-over-union scores between two BoxMaskList mask collections
compute_mask_ioa: compute pairwise intersection-over-area scores between two BoxMaskList mask collections
non_max_suppression_masks: apply non-maximum suppression to a BoxMaskList using mask-based IOU and score thresholds
multi_class_nms_masks: apply multi-class non-maximum suppression to a BoxMaskList across all classes
filter_scores_greater_than: filter a BoxMaskList to keep only boxes and masks with scores above a threshold
